dedupe_keys.name: us commuting backbone network gis and tables

description: The commuting backbone team publishes United States commuter-connection and road-backbone networks through one Figshare deposit under CC BY 4.0. The article describes a tract-to-tract commuter CSV, corresponding line geometries, inferred primary road segments and metropolitan-area network metrics. These files can provide a coarse commuting demand and route structure for transport network or accessibility simulations. Coverage is US metropolitan statistical areas represented in the source commuting data. A caveat is that road backbones are inferred from origin-destination flows and a GIS matching procedure, not observed vehicle paths; the spatial distribution should not be treated as a traffic count on every segment. The own archive also includes code and ArcGIS procedure notes, but the workflow is not fully automated. I read the own Figshare metadata and article Data Records without downloading the archive, checking road matching or running assignment. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
